faceted/stone.reason: Pale fractured stone reads as rock at 32 px; lit planes and grain replace the jewel-like old facets.

faceted/wood.reason: Bark, cut end and end-grain hold at 64 px; a broad warm log silhouette remains at 32 px.

faceted/wheat.reason: Broader lit grain planes produce a stronger crop silhouette at 32 px; painted edges hold at 64 px.

faceted/fish.reason: Silver scales and a clear tail replace the bright blue polygon fish and its ground shadow.

faceted/labor.reason: A gripping hand and working hammer fill the square better than the distant full-body worker.

faceted/essence.reason: The bottle remains clear at both sizes. Glass and violet volume improve at 64 px; the old magenta bottle is equally distinct at 32 px.

faceted/ironwood.reason: Dense bark and red end-grain distinguish it from ordinary wood; the old black log has comparable contrast at 32 px.

faceted/fragment.reason: The orange-green shard retains its identity; surface light improves at 64 px but the old silhouette is already strong.

faceted/realm.reason: Stone gate and slate roofs establish a material building instead of a monochrome gold token. Level remains an external badge.

faceted/camp.reason: Both tents read at 32 px. The new canvas has stronger folds at 64 px without adding another visual object.

faceted/hyperstructure.reason: Stone spires and the lit core give the site material depth missing from the flat old emblem.

faceted/chest.reason: Wood and iron separate clearly at both sizes, replacing the all-gold chest with a readable object.

faceted/move.reason: Leather boots retain material detail at 64 px. The old footprints are faster as a pure sign at 32 px.

faceted/explore.reason: The map and lens have convincing depth; the old eye is simpler at 32 px. The map distinguishes this from a watch-only spyglass.

faceted/attack.reason: A lit blade is clean and free of the old shield frame. Its narrow silhouette is less prominent but remains legible at 32 px.

faceted/build.reason: The mallet and block match the shipped material quality; removing the second tool makes the 32 px subject cleaner.

faceted/trade.reason: The iron balance keeps the familiar scale silhouette with clear pans. Small chains still merge at 32 px as in the old art.

faceted/stamina.reason: Amber depth is stronger at 64 px; the old lightning silhouette is equally clear at 32 px. This meaning is reserved for stamina.

faceted/victory.reason: The silver trophy and green laurel have clearer volume than the flat old cup at 32 and 64 px.

faceted/settings.reason: One iron gear reads more clearly than the framed dial and key, with enough face shading to feel physical.

faceted/chat.reason: Two painted speech forms preserve the conversation meaning and remove the gold rim; ivory faces stay clear at 32 px.

faceted/map-army.reason: An unframed helmet preserves a compact military silhouette; painted light replaces the old shield engraving.

faceted/map-realm.reason: A broad gate and crenellations preserve the site silhouette while leaving ownership to the surrounding shape.

faceted/knight-t1.reason: Open face, mail and red neckcloth read at 24 px; the shipped full figure is much smaller. Plain helmet separates T1 from the closed T2 and crested T3.

faceted/knight-t2.reason: The approved armoured bust fills the square more clearly than the shipped figure. Closed steel helmet and red mantle sit between the open T1 and crested T3.

faceted/knight-t3.reason: Large red crest and layered shoulder plates survive 24 px reduction. Shipped tiers reuse the same small figure; this silhouette identifies the richest knight.

faceted/crossbowman-t1.reason: A visible face under a green hood and a held wooden crossbow replace the weapon-only study. The broad brown weapon and hood remain visible at 24 px.

faceted/crossbowman-t2.reason: Steel kettle helmet and plated shoulders separate this soldier from the hooded T1. The held crossbow remains clear; small face detail needs 32 px.

faceted/crossbowman-t3.reason: The large green crest, bright crossbow limbs and broad plate distinguish the veteran at 24 px. Shipped tiers have the same thin full-body silhouette.

faceted/paladin-t1.reason: Ivory hood, visible face, upright sword and blue-white tabard read as a holy warrior. The shipped mounted figure remains a strong silhouette; this is a different close portrait.

faceted/paladin-t2.reason: Winged steel helmet replaces the T1 hood while the sword and blue-white tabard preserve the type. Shipped mount is clearer as cavalry; the portrait is clearer as armour.

faceted/paladin-t3.reason: White crest and bright layered plate enlarge the top silhouette at 24 px. Blue-white cloth and upright sword preserve the holy warrior identity without a shield.

faceted/map-village.reason: Paired red roofs distinguish village from the pale realm towers. The compact painted houses retain material at 32 px and roof colour at 12–16 px.

faceted/map-mine.reason: Dark opening and green crystal give mine a distinct colour mass. Fine pickaxe detail falls away at 12 px; the entrance and crystal carry the reading.
